leadText: Kensuke Satō (Japanese: 佐藤健輔 Satō Kensuke) is a Japanese voice actor for .
plainText:
Kensuke Satō (Japanese: 佐藤健輔 Satō Kensuke) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Satō was born sometime on May 14 in , . He started to work on Pokémon in . His most notable roles are Ingo, Iris's Dragonite, and Clemont's Luxray.

He shares most of his roles with Tom Wayland and Marc Thompson in the English dub.
